summary.one_liner: Ramme is an unofficial desktop app for Instagram that runs on macOS, Linux and Windows, though its README says it is no longer maintained.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Ramme as an unofficial Instagram desktop client, with a download for macOS, Linux and Windows. Listed features are photo upload, a dark theme, auto update, keyboard shortcuts, and background behavior. Keyboard shortcuts cover going back, refreshing, switching between Home, Discover, Notifications and Profile, scrolling a post up or down, and toggling dark mode. The README says macOS 10.9+, Windows 7+ and Linux are supported. The name comes from the Danish word for frame. The README includes a legal note that the app is not affiliated with or endorsed by Instagram.
use_cases: Browsing Instagram in a desktop window
Uploading photos to Instagram from a computer
Using Instagram with a dark theme
how_to_run: Download the latest release for macOS, Linux or Windows from the release link in the README
notable: Unofficial Instagram client for macOS, Linux and Windows
Keyboard shortcuts for navigation, refresh and dark mode
Photo upload from the desktop app
caveats: The README states Ramme is no longer being maintained
Unofficial app, not affiliated with or endorsed by Instagram; the README says to use it at your own risk
Supported platforms are macOS 10.9+, Windows 7+ and Linux
